name: Gathered Semicircle
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a desktop product/docs homepage
Primary request: Design the full first 1.6 viewports of the Agent Factory homepage in the locked Drawcord System visual world. Composition A: Gathered Semicircle. A slim navigation leads to an asymmetric first viewport with concise product proposition at upper left and a monumental black silk semicircle occupying roughly two-thirds of the screen. Five gold routed cords travel through real workflow stations and physically gather at a large install control on the right edge. Immediately below, paired Shape Work and Do Work lifecycle diagrams begin as two stitched paths, proving they are separate lifecycles. Install must be unmistakably first.
Real content: Agent Factory; From work item to ready change.; Install Agent Factory; Shape work; Do work; Codex; Claude Code; OpenCode. Do not invent testimonials, metrics, customers, prices, or capabilities.
Visual system: near-black silk #121317, muted drawcord gold #B79A55, graphite/slate #4A4E57, warm chalk #E5E0D4. Narrow tailored grotesk for labels; readable workhorse sans for body. Gold routing cords, graphite stitching, gathered matte folds, cord-anchor controls. No generic rounded SaaS cards.
Composition/framing: straight-on 1536x1024 desktop webpage, no browser chrome; high-fidelity web UI comp, not a poster or product photo. Show enough second fold to prove the system.
Avoid generic AI motifs, robots, brains, chat bubbles, neon, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, glowing nodes, bento grids, literal cape photography, model imagery, and watermarks.
